facts.fact: Streaming TV (CTV) ad spend is $33 billion in 2025 according to the page.
facts.quote: The $33 billion market is accessible to businesses at virtually any budget level.

facts.fact: The page recommends a streaming TV test budget of $200-500 running for two weeks (vendor recommendation).
facts.quote: $200-500 for two weeks provides meaningful data

facts.fact: Adwave claims a $500 campaign running two weeks in a defined market can generate 20,000+ impressions among local households (vendor claim, not independently verified).
facts.quote: A $500 campaign running for two weeks in a defined market can generate 20,000+ impressions among local households

facts.fact: Total digital video ad spend in 2025 is $72 billion.
facts.quote: Total digital video (2025)

facts.fact: CTV/streaming TV represents 46% of total digital video ad spend in 2025.
facts.quote: (46% of digital video)

facts.fact: Social video ad spend is $27 billion, or 38% of digital video, in 2025.
facts.quote: **Social video:** $27 billion (38% of digital video)

facts.fact: Online video (non-CTV) ad spend is $12 billion, or 16% of digital video, in 2025.
facts.quote: Online video (non-CTV):** $12 billion (16% of digital video)

facts.fact: Streaming was about 15% of TV ad spend in 2020.
facts.quote: **2020:** Streaming was ~15% of TV ad spend

facts.fact: Streaming was about 38% of TV ad spend in 2025.
facts.quote: **2025:** Streaming is ~38% of TV ad spend

facts.fact: Streaming's share of TV ad spend is projected to reach about 45% in 2027.
facts.quote: **2027:** Streaming projected to reach ~45% of TV ad spend

facts.fact: CTV ad spend is projected to exceed linear TV advertising for the first time by 2028.
facts.quote: By 2028, CTV ad spend is projected to exceed linear TV advertising for the first time.

facts.fact: The combined TV advertising market (linear plus streaming) will approach $90 billion in 2025.
facts.quote: will approach $90 billion in 2025

facts.fact: Linear TV ad spend is approximately $55 billion in 2025, compared with $33 billion for CTV.
facts.quote: approximately $55 billion in linear spend versus $33 billion in CTV for 2025

facts.fact: Linear TV advertising declined 7% year-over-year, while CTV grew 16% year-over-year.
facts.quote: linear is declining (down 7% year-over-year) while CTV is growing (up 16% year-over-year)

facts.fact: CTV ad spending grew 16% year-over-year in 2024.
facts.quote: CTV ad spending grew 16% year-over-year in 2024

facts.fact: Projections suggest 13-17% CTV growth continuing through 2026-2027.
facts.quote: Projections suggest 13-17% growth continuing through 2026-2027

facts.fact: The CTV market is expected to reach $40-42 billion by 2027.
facts.quote: the market is expected to reach $40-42 billion

facts.fact: Total advertising growth is approximately 6-8%, according to the page.
facts.quote: approximately 6-8%

facts.fact: Social media advertising totals approximately $80 billion including all formats.
facts.quote: approximately $80 billion including all formats

facts.fact: According to eMarketer, 70.7% of the U.S. population uses CTV.
facts.quote: With 70.7% of the U.S. population now using CTV

facts.fact: Americans now spend nearly half their TV viewing time on streaming platforms, per the page.
facts.quote: Americans now spend nearly half their TV viewing time on streaming platforms

facts.fact: The page states that typical low minimums are $50 starting budgets instead of $50,000.

facts.fact: Adwave claims access to 100+ premium channels, the same as major brands use (vendor claim).
